judge: Claude (N1C integrator), single rater, not blind to layer; procedure: part A (top-10 + 6 sampled top-1% contexts, enriched input/next tokens) judged for all 48 poles BEFORE reading part B (causal top/bottom tokens, J-VINDEX, naive, gate).

rubric.act_one: >= 7 of the 10 top contexts share one describable feature (token, concept, syntax, topic)
rubric.act_two: two describable features together cover >= 7/10, neither alone does
rubric.act_unclear: no one or two features cover 7/10
rubric.act_conf: high = obvious, medium = clear but needs a slightly abstract description, low = borderline
rubric.out_coherent: causal top-15 tokens form one describable set
rubric.out_partial: only the bottom (suppressed) set or an orthographic/prefix family is coherent
rubric.out_generic: L10-30 tokens shared across unrelated neurons (generic perturbation response; same junk tokens recur)
rubric.related: the trigger (activation side) and the causal effect describe one computation (e.g. fires on 'super', pushes '()')

version numbers of graphics APIs (OpenGL 1.1, GL 1.X, X11)
